facts.fact: Subsea analyst Roderick Beck says Equiano has an on-net carrier-neutral point of presence at OADC in Lagos, and Medallion's LOS20 and LOS21 data centres are the two 2Africa hand-off points.

Subsea analyst Roderick Beck says all Nigerian cable landings are at Lekki except 2Africa, which has two landings, one 500 km south of Lagos, alongside WACS, ACE, MainOne, SAT3, GLO-1 and Equiano; he expected 2Africa live by early 2025.
facts.system: WACS, ACE, MainOne, SAT3, GLO-1, Equiano, 2Africa

NGA.note: Ownership of the named data centres is not stated.
Nothing on satellite broadband in Nigeria.
